```{r}
# Change the corruption measure to either ncorrupt_os, pcorrupt, or valor_corrupt
data$valor_corrupt <- ifelse(data$valor_corrupt > 0, 1, 0)
data$ncorrupt_os <- ifelse(data$ncorrupt_os > 0, 1, 0)
data$pcorrupt <- ifelse(data$pcorrupt > 0, 1, 0)

print("Checking inputs to glm:")
print(head(data))
print(colnames(data))

# Fit the logistic regression model and change the formula to represent the selected formula
propensity_model <- glm(
  formula = formula_used, 
  data = data, 
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# Summarize the logistic regression model
summary(propensity_model)

# Calculate propensity scores and add them to the dataset
data$propensity_score <- predict(propensity_model, type = "response")

# View the first few rows of the updated dataset
head(data)

# Plot the distribution of propensity scores (Change the corruption measure in fill = as.factor(pcorrupt))) and fill = "Treatment (pcorrupt)"
hist_plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = propensity_score, fill = as.factor(ncorrupt_os))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.5, position = "identity") +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of Propensity Scores",
    x = "Propensity Score",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Treatment (ncorrupt_os)"
  )

print(hist_plot)
```

```{r}
# Function to fit a specified machine learning model
fit_model <- function(X, Y, model_type = "lasso", ...) {
  if (model_type == "lasso") {
    return(cv.glmnet(X, Y, alpha = 1, family = "gaussian"))
  } else if (model_type == "rf") {
    return(randomForest(x = X, y = Y, ...))
  } else if (model_type == "tree") {
    return(rpart(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X, Y = Y)))
  } else if (model_type == "nnet") {
    # Handle missing values in X
    X[is.na(X)] <- apply(X, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    X_scaled <- scale(X)  # Scale predictors
    return(nnet(X_scaled, Y, size = 5, linout = TRUE, trace = FALSE, ...))
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported model type")
  }
}

# Function to predict using a fitted model
predict_model <- function(model, X_new, model_type = "lasso") {
  # Handle missing values in X_new
  if (any(is.na(X_new))) {
    print("Imputing missing values in X_new...")
    X_new[is.na(X_new)] <- apply(X_new, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (model_type == "lasso") {
    return(as.vector(predict(model, newx = X_new, s = "lambda.min")))
  } else if (model_type %in% c("rf", "tree")) {
    return(predict(model, newdata = data.frame(X_new)))
  } else if (model_type == "nnet") {
    # Scale predictors
    X_new_scaled <- scale(X_new)
    
    # Check for missing values after scaling
    if (any(is.na(X_new_scaled))) {
      print("Error: X_new_scaled contains missing values after scaling.")
      X_new_scaled[is.na(X_new_scaled)] <- 0  # Replace NAs with 0 as a fallback
    }
    
    return(as.vector(predict(model, newdata = X_new_scaled)))
   } else {
    stop("Unsupported model type")
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Custom Double Machine Learning Function for IRM
double_ml_irm <- function(data, y_col, d_col, x_cols, z_col = NULL, k = 5, 
                          model_g = "lasso", model_m = "lasso", trimming_threshold = 1e-2) {
 if (!all(c(y_col, d_col, x_cols) %in% colnames(data))) {
    stop("One or more specified columns are missing in the data.")
  }
  
  # Extract variables
  Y <- as.matrix(data[[y_col]])
  D <- as.matrix(data[[d_col]])
  X <- as.matrix(data[x_cols])

  # Ensure no NULL or NA entries
  if (is.null(Y) || is.null(D) || is.null(X)) {
    stop("One or more inputs (Y, D, or X) are NULL.")
  }
   # Convert data to data frame if it is a data.table
  if (inherits(data, "data.table")) data <- as.data.frame(data)
  
  Z <- if (!is.null(z_col)) as.matrix(data[[z_col]]) else NULL
  n <- nrow(data)
  
  # Create cross-validation folds
  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(Y, k = k, list = TRUE)
  
  # Initialize storage for predictions
  g_hat <- rep(NA, n)
  m_hat <- rep(NA, n)
  prop_scores <- rep(NA, n)  # Store propensity scores for trimming
  
  # Cross-fitting
  for (fold in 1:k) {
    # Split data into training and test sets
    test_idx <- folds[[fold]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(1:n, test_idx)
    
    X_train <- X[train_idx, ]
    Y_train <- Y[train_idx]
    D_train <- D[train_idx]
    X_test <- X[test_idx, ]
    
    # Combine Z and X if Z is provided, otherwise use X only
    if (!is.null(Z)) {
      Z_train <- Z[train_idx, ]
      Z_test <- Z[test_idx, ]
      XZ_train <- cbind(Z_train, X_train)
      XZ_test <- cbind(Z_test, X_test)
    } else {
      XZ_train <- X_train
      XZ_test <- X_test
    }
    
    # Fit and predict outcome model (g(X))
    g_model <- fit_model(X_train, Y_train, model_g)
    g_hat[test_idx] <- predict_model(g_model, X_test, model_g)
    
    # Fit and predict treatment model (m(Z, X) or m(X))
    m_model <- fit_model(XZ_train, D_train, model_m)
    m_hat[test_idx] <- predict_model(m_model, XZ_test, model_m)
    
    # Calculate propensity scores (for trimming)
    prop_scores[test_idx] <- m_hat[test_idx]
  }
  
  # Trim based on propensity scores
  trim_mask <- prop_scores > trimming_threshold & prop_scores < (1 - trimming_threshold)
  if (sum(trim_mask) == 0) stop("No observations left after trimming. Adjust the trimming threshold.")
  
  # Residual of Y and D using trimmed data
  u_Y <- (Y - g_hat)[trim_mask]
  u_D <- (D - m_hat)[trim_mask]
  
  # Estimate causal effect
  theta_model <- lm(u_Y ~ u_D - 1)
  theta <- coef(theta_model)[1]
  
  # Robust standard errors
  residuals <- theta_model$residuals
  X_residual <- as.matrix(cbind(u_D))
  bread <- solve(t(X_residual) %*% X_residual)
  meat <- t(X_residual) %*% diag(residuals^2) %*% X_residual
  sandwich <- bread %*% meat %*% bread
  std_error <- sqrt(diag(sandwich))[1]
  
  # t-value and p-value
  t_value <- theta / std_error
  p_value <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_value), df = sum(trim_mask) - 1))
  
  # MSE and RMSE for models (on trimmed data)
  mse_g <- mean((Y[trim_mask] - g_hat[trim_mask])^2)
  mse_m <- mean((D[trim_mask] - m_hat[trim_mask])^2)
  rmse_g <- sqrt(mse_g)
  rmse_m <- sqrt(mse_m)
  
  # Compile results
  results <- list(
    theta = theta,
    std_error = std_error,
    t_value = t_value,
    p_value = p_value,
    rmse_g = rmse_g,
    rmse_m = rmse_m,
    trimmed_n = sum(trim_mask),  # Number of observations after trimming
    trimming_threshold = trimming_threshold
  )
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
# Custom Double Machine Learning Function for PLR
double_ml_plr <- function(data, y_col, d_col, x_cols, k = 5, model_g = "lasso", model_m = "lasso") {
  if (!all(c(y_col, d_col, x_cols) %in% colnames(data))) {
    stop("One or more specified columns are missing in the data.")
  }
  
  # Extract variables
  Y <- as.matrix(data[[y_col]])
  D <- as.matrix(data[[d_col]])
  X <- as.matrix(data[x_cols])

  # Ensure no NULL or NA entries
  if (is.null(Y) || is.null(D) || is.null(X)) {
    stop("One or more inputs (Y, D, or X) are NULL.")
  }
  # Convert data to data frame if it is a data.table
  if (inherits(data, "data.table")) data <- as.data.frame(data)
  
  # Extract variables
  Y <- as.matrix(data[[y_col]])
  D <- as.matrix(data[[d_col]])
  X <- as.matrix(data[x_cols])
  n <- nrow(data)
  
  # Create cross-validation folds
  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(Y, k = k, list = TRUE)
  
  # Initialize storage for predictions
  g_hat <- rep(NA, n)
  m_hat <- rep(NA, n)
  
  # Cross-fitting
  for (fold in 1:k) {
    # Split data into training and test sets
    test_idx <- folds[[fold]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(1:n, test_idx)
    
    X_train <- X[train_idx, ]
    Y_train <- Y[train_idx]
    D_train <- D[train_idx]
    X_test <- X[test_idx, ]
    
    # Fit and predict outcome model (g(X))
    g_model <- fit_model(X_train, Y_train, model_g)
    g_hat[test_idx] <- predict_model(g_model, X_test, model_g)
    
    # Fit and predict treatment model (m(X))
    m_model <- fit_model(X_train, D_train, model_m)
    m_hat[test_idx] <- predict_model(m_model, X_test, model_m)
  }
  
  # Residual Y and D
  u_Y <- Y - g_hat
  u_D <- D - m_hat
  
  # Estimate causal effect
  theta_model <- lm(u_Y ~ u_D - 1)
  theta <- coef(theta_model)[1]
  
  # Robust standard errors
  residuals <- theta_model$residuals
  X_residual <- as.matrix(cbind(u_D))
  bread <- solve(t(X_residual) %*% X_residual)
  meat <- t(X_residual) %*% diag(residuals^2) %*% X_residual
  sandwich <- bread %*% meat %*% bread
  std_error <- sqrt(diag(sandwich))[1]
  
  # t-value and p-value
  t_value <- theta / std_error
  p_value <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_value), df = n - 1))
  
  # MSE and RMSE for models
  mse_g <- mean((Y - g_hat)^2)
  mse_m <- mean((D - m_hat)^2)
  rmse_g <- sqrt(mse_g)
  rmse_m <- sqrt(mse_m)
  
  # Compile results
  results <- list(
    theta = theta,
    std_error = std_error,
    t_value = t_value,
    p_value = p_value,
    rmse_g = rmse_g,
    rmse_m = rmse_m
  )
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
# Define the models to evaluate
model_types <- c("lasso", "tree", "rf", "nnet")

# Initialize a list to store results
plr_results <- list()

# Iterate over the model types
for (model in model_types) {
  cat("Evaluating PLR with", model, "...\n")
  
  # Run PLR for the current model type and change y-col to appropriate corruption measure (pcorrupt, ncorrupt_os, or valor_corrupt)
  results <- tryCatch({
    double_ml_plr(
      data = model_val,
      y_col = "ncorrupt_os",
      d_col = "first",
      x_cols = x_val,
      k = 5,
      model_g = model,
      model_m = model
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error evaluating PLR with", model, ":", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # Store results in a list
  if (!is.null(results)) {
    plr_results[[model]] <- data.frame(
      model = model,
      theta = results$theta,
      std_error = results$std_error,
      t_value = results$t_value,
      p_value = results$p_value,
      rmse_g = results$rmse_g,
      rmse_m = results$rmse_m
    )
  }
}

# Combine all results into a single data frame
plr_results_df <- do.call(rbind, plr_results)

# Print the results as a data frame
cat("Summary of PLR Results:\n")
print(plr_results_df)
```

```{r}
# Define the models to evaluate
model_types <- c("lasso", "tree", "rf", "nnet")

# Initialize a list to store results
irm_results <- list()

# Iterate over the model types
for (model in model_types) {
  cat("Evaluating IRM with", model, "...\n")
  
  # Run IRM for the current model type and change y-col to appropriate corruption measure (pcorrupt, ncorrupt_os, or valor_corrupt)
  results <- tryCatch({
    double_ml_irm(
      data = model_val,
      y_col = "ncorrupt_os",
      d_col = "first",
      x_cols = x_val,
      z_col = NULL,  # No instrument
      k = 5,
      model_g = model,
      model_m = model,
      trimming_threshold = 1e-2  # Apply trimming threshold
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error evaluating IRM with", model, ":", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # Store results in a list
  if (!is.null(results)) {
    irm_results[[model]] <- data.frame(
      model = model,
      theta = results$theta,
      std_error = results$std_error,
      t_value = results$t_value,
      p_value = results$p_value,
      rmse_g = results$rmse_g,
      rmse_m = results$rmse_m
    )
  }
}

# Combine all results into a single data frame
irm_results_df <- do.call(rbind, irm_results)

# Print the results as a data frame
cat("Summary of IRM Results:\n")
print(irm_results_df)
```
